data.one_liner: A simple Flutter plugin to create blinking text with adjustable duration, color, and blink count.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a BlinkText widget that allows developers to create text that blinks. It supports customizing the begin color, end color, duration of the blink animation, and the total number of times the text blinks before stopping.
use_when: You need a simple blinking text effect in your UI.
You want to specify the exact number of times text should blink.
You want to animate text color changes or opacity changes.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based or multi-stage text animations.
You are building performance-critical UIs with hundreds of simultaneous continuous blinking elements.
strengths: Very easy to use with standard TextStyle properties.
Supports custom blink counts and durations.
Allows defining both beginning and ending colors.
data.minimal_example:
const BlinkText(
	'Blink Animation',
	style: TextStyle(fontSize: 48.0, color: Colors.redAccent),
	beginColor: Colors.black,
	endColor: Colors.orange,
	times: 10,
	duration: Duration(seconds: 1)
)
